A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same UFVideo research. The method, equations, Tables 1–9, Figures 1–13, and supplementary Sections A–D can be matched reliably. The shorter later PDF retains the appendix material.

before.justification: v1 reports original UFVideo benchmark evaluations and ablations in Tables 1–7, additional ReVOS results in Table 9, and qualitative outputs in the appendix.

after.justification: v2 retains these original quantitative experiments, ablations, and qualitative outputs, including revised scores in Table 6.

M1.justification: The VideoRefer-based architecture, visual and region encoders, SAM2 decoder, temporal/referring/segmentation tokens, training objectives, and two-stage training procedure are unchanged. Spelling and benchmark-name corrections do not alter the method.

E1.justification: The training datasets in Table 8 and evaluation coverage in Tables 1–6 and 9 are retained. Both versions cover the same general understanding, object referring, segmentation, temporal grounding, and PixRQA/PixHQA/PixTRQA tasks.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged across the corresponding tables, including the appendix ReVOS comparison. Table 6 still compares UFVideo with GPT-4o and Qwen3-VL 8B/32B; the changed Qwen reference does not change the named evaluated models.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 revises the reported training hardware from 32 A100 (80G) GPUs to 32 A800 (80G) GPUs, a limited change to the stated experimental setup. Splits, metrics, batch sizes, epochs, learning rates, and token settings remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: Table 7 retains the same task-unification ablations and comparisons of absolute time with relative temporal tokens at 50, 100, and 150 tokens. The appendix qualitative cases in Figures 6–13 are also retained, with no new robustness or error analysis.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or statistical significance tests. The reporting of single scalar results is unchanged.

E6.justification: Table 6 changes four PixHQA SAvg,w/oT scores: GPT-4o 7.35 to 4.27, Qwen3-VL 8B 7.18 to 4.11, Qwen3-VL 32B 7.51 to 4.34, and UFVideo 7.56 to 4.41. Their ranking is preserved. Other reported numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged; these revisions do not establish a performance gain or loss.

T1.justification: The task formulation and Equations 1–9 retain the same mathematical content. No formal assumptions, propositions, proofs, or substantive derivations are added or revised.

C1.justification: The introduction's second contribution changes from introducing a novel UFVideo-Bench to explicitly claiming to be the first to introduce such a benchmark. The main claims about unified multi-grained understanding, task synergy, and benchmark performance otherwise remain unchanged.

C2.justification: The interpretations concerning complementary granularities, mutual task enhancement, and the 100-token computational tradeoff are retained. Supplementary Section D preserves the limitation concerning insufficient attention to image-level understanding and the same future-work direction.

D1.justification: The GPU designation in Section 4.1 changes from A100 to A800 while retaining the count and stated memory. Other implementation settings, supplementary training recipes and annotation prompts, and code/data access statements remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds Step-Audio, replaces the Qwen3-VL technical-report entry with a Qwen3 technical-report entry, and removes AdvEDM, BadRobot, AdvCLIP, DarkSAM, and Vanish into Thin Air. The central positioning against RGA3, UniPixel, and LLaVA-ST remains intact, while benchmark priority becomes explicit.

P1.justification: v2 corrects spelling and terminology, including Unibench to UFVideo-Bench and VideRefer to VideoRefer, and shortens some supplementary-material references. Author contact/correspondence information changes and an acknowledgment section is added. The scientific narrative and section organization are largely retained.

P2.justification: Tables 2 and 3 are repositioned on page 6, surrounding text and the conclusion reflow, page-number footers disappear, and several captions receive wording corrections. All nine tables and thirteen figures remain; no new visual analysis or substantial redesign is introduced.

improvement.justification: The revised Table 6 PixHQA scores fall within the stated 0–5 semantic scoring scale, resolving an internal inconsistency in v1 without changing rankings. Terminology and spelling corrections also improve clarity. These are limited reporting gains: the score revisions are unexplained, and replacing the Qwen3-VL report citation with the less specific Qwen3 report weakens attribution.
